credits.title: Red Days 2: Cecilia
credits.overview: Following the path of Cecilia, from Red Days, a young woman becomes a vampire during a zombie outbreak. In order to survive and find a new home, she joins a secret organization that turns her into a corporate slayer.

credits.title: Mendocino
credits.overview: A lawyer faces ancestral violence and haunting memories in a California farmhouse, exploring guilt and redemption.

credits.title: Verticals: The Movie
credits.overview: When a young aspiring actor, Milo, arrives to his first acting job ever, he’s quickly hit by the realization that this isn’t just any film set…this is a vertical drama set. credits.title: The Stepbrother I Hate to Love
credits.overview: Noah is a straight, nerdy student whose stepbrother, Liam—a charming, playboy ice hockey captain—keeps stealing his girlfriends and messes with him both at home and school. A drunken threesome setup turns to a bet that changes everything.

credits.title: Dungeons of Ecstasy
credits.overview: After a crash, a journalist flees to Italy and is trapped in the "Dungeons of Ecstasy" by a captor who resembles her long-lost ex-husband.

credits.title: Trucker
credits.overview: A trucker's family is killed in a fiery crash caused by a group of reckless teens. Rescued from the wreckage and nursed back to health by a mysterious old man, the trucker exacts brutal revenge on the teens who destroyed his life.

credits.title: Lady Outlaw
credits.overview: Outlaws George Newcomb and Rose Dunn try to make it back to Ingalls, Oklahoma with lawmen and bounty hunters on their trail.
